text:
eli-sales: Quick sync request — NimbusPay POC. They want to swap from BlueAPI to Redwood for payments-chat assistant. Main asks: pricing parity for high-throughput (30k reqs/day), can we hit response parity for their prompts, KMS + HSM questions, and public IPs for their staging. Can we triage risks before Friday demo?

maria-se: +1. I can run parity tests. Need sample prompt set and 1000 example conversations. Also need their current `Accept-Language` and tokenization quirks (they use a custom tokenizer).

eli-sales: attaching initial prompt set link from customer (they dropped in a GDrive link). They also flagged 2 responses that BlueAPI returns with slightly different entity formatting.

josh-ml: re: response parity — we should run a diff on normalized outputs. Two quick options: 1) shim layer that maps BlueAPI JSON -> Redwood JSON (fast, but could hide semantic deltas) or 2) adapt prompts + post-processing to preserve their downstream schema. I prefer prompt + postprocess for maintainability.

maria-se: agree. For POC timeline: day 1 network + credentials, day 2 baseline parity run (1000 convs), day 3 tuning, day 4 SLA/costing + security review. Can we commit to that?

anita-security: from security side: we need answers to these in their questionnaire: 1) Do they want BYOK via KMS/HSM? 2) Data residency requirement? 3) IP allowlist for staging and prod? 4) Will logs be forwarded to their SIEM? Provide their completed questionnaire by EOD and we'll start review. Also note: for BYOK we need their KMS ARN + support window for key rotation.

eli-sales: they confirmed BYOK + EU residency for production, staging in us-west-2, and yes SIEM forward. They've asked about our HSM attestation and SOC2 controls.

lena-legal: we'll need a tailored DPA + addendum for BYOK + HSM handling. Also check export controls for crypto. I'll draft a template; expect a first pass tomorrow.

maria-se: pricing — customer wants a cost model comparable to current vendor: they pay per-request + burst discounts. We should propose: reserved slot pricing for steady baseline + overage per token for bursts. I'll prep numbers but need expected token per request (avg).

eli-sales: avg tokens ~420/request (customer says heavy context). Also they're sensitive to tail latency > 500ms per request.

josh-ml: for latency: recommend 1) quantized model in dedicated pool, 2) enable prefix KV caching for repeated contexts, 3) route low-latency-critical routes to a smaller context model variant. I can run microbenchmarks next 48h.

maria-se: deployment notes for POC infra: need 2 public static IPs for staging (they'll IP allowlist), a short-lived service account for logs->SIEM, and sample webhook for stream responses. @sam-deploy-bot can you pre-allocate staging IPs and a sandbox project?

sam-deploy-bot: noted — reserving 2 ephemeral egress IPs in us-west-2 for team-redwood-staging-nimbus. ETA 4 hours. Will post CIDR and NAT details here when ready.

anita-security: once IPs are posted send over firewall rules and I'll run network scan. Also we require a completed data flow diagram before enabling SIEM forwarders.

eli-sales: thanks everyone. Action items: @maria-se run parity baseline + cost calc, @josh-ml microbenchmarks, @anita-security security questionnaire review + network scan, @lena-legal draft DPA. I'll coordinate with Nimbus to get the prompt corpus and sample logs now. Let's aim to have POC kickoff Monday. :thumbsup:
